sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
BA/BS or equivalent completed by matriculation; UChicago bachelor’s qualifies formally. International
applications welcomed. Pure math PhD only; master’s available en route, not terminal admission. [s3] [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use GSAS portal; secure three academic evaluations, transcripts, mathematically focused SOP and any
research you want evaluated. Complete fee-waiver questions before payment. No pre-arranged advisor stated.
[s1] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Admissions committee reviews program applications; no prior supervisor agreement listed. Research-fit leads
below do not establish willingness to take new students. [s1] [s11]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use Applicant Portal checklist; submitted application cannot be edited or supplemented (contact info
exception). Required written work must be applicant’s own; Harvard prohibits using generative AI to develop
written application content, allowing minor editing/grammar assistance only. [s3] [s6]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Math application deadline explicitly confirmed for Fall 2027; response page remains 2026. [s2] [s10]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Non-native speakers can establish proficiency with an English-medium undergraduate degree. Otherwise
current central minimum: TOEFL 5 overall/4.5 speaking (95/23 pre-21 Jan 2026) or IELTS 7 overall/6.5
speaking. Master’s alone does not satisfy the undergraduate-degree exemption. [s7]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
English-taught UChicago undergraduate degree meets degree-based proof of proficiency. For a degree still in
progress, verify portal handling rather than assume completed-degree wording is waived automatically. [s7] [s3]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Not accepted. [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Central program: optional. Department: recommended; without a score one less evaluation datum is available
and omission may disadvantage an otherwise marginal file. Thus optional-but-recommended, not indifferent.
[s1] [s2]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three; at least one from faculty at latest degree institution unless out of school more than five years. Extra
letters allowed but review not guaranteed. [s5]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Ordinary GSAS package is coordinated with admission; no separate mathematics scholarship essay/reference
form identified. Fulbright/home-country and other outside awards have distinct applications. [s1] [s8]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
Not established from the public sources reviewed. Verify in the current application or with graduate admissions
before relying on this item.
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
You may submit application before letters arrive; letters still due by program deadline. Exact invitation trigger
was not stated in reviewed public guidance. [s5]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Applicant Portal tracks received materials with green checkmarks, including references and official scores. [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
No email/mail/dossier-service letters; recommender portal only. General submitted application cannot be
edited except contact information. Specific policy on replacement of submitted letters/reuse across years was
not established. [s5] [s6]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
Incoming package covers tuition, health insurance fees and basic living expenses, but an explicit 2027-28
mathematics annual stipend was not found. Central stipend page says amounts/payment schedules vary by
individual package; do not import another department’s stipend. [s8] [s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Specific duration appears in Notice of Financial Support at admission. Department describes first-year
scholarship and teaching in years 2-5; this is not itself a precise five-year dollar guarantee. [s1] [s8]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department identifies aid for applicants without outside support and directs international students to
Fulbright/home-country awards; central package is for incoming PhD students. Individual award eligibility still
must be checked. [s1] [s8]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Continued full-time enrollment and satisfactory academic progress. Department normally expects a teaching
fellowship for one course in each of years 2-5 when not externally supported. [s1] [s8]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Ordinary GSAS package is coordinated with admission; no separate mathematics scholarship essay/reference
form identified. Fulbright/home-country and other outside awards have distinct applications. [s1] [s8]

Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Institutional scholarships/teaching/research appointments and external awards. Department lists Fulbright IIE
and home-country funding for international applicants; NSF/NDSEG generally should not be presumed eligible
solely from F-1 enrollment. [s1] [s8]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 105, nonrefundable, credit card. [s3]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Application Fee section asks eligibility questions and immediately returns a fee-waiver determination.
Complete these before paying; no separate public math waiver deadline or guaranteed international eligibility
found. [s3]

text:
Harvard University
United States · PhD in Pure Mathematics
2026 US News roster/rank verified separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Harvard Mathematics does not accept a personal statement or GRE General scores.
• Write a mathematically substantive SOP, at most 1,000 words.
• Do not relabel the currently published April 2026 response date as April 2027.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
BA/BS or equivalent completed by matriculation; UChicago bachelor’s qualifies formally. International
applications welcomed. Pure math PhD only; master’s available en route, not terminal admission. [s3] [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use GSAS portal; secure three academic evaluations, transcripts, mathematically focused SOP and any
research you want evaluated. Complete fee-waiver questions before payment. No pre-arranged advisor stated.
[s1] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Admissions committee reviews program applications; no prior supervisor agreement listed. Research-fit leads
below do not establish willingness to take new students. [s1] [s11]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use Applicant Portal checklist; submitted application cannot be edited or supplemented (contact info
exception). Required written work must be applicant’s own; Harvard prohibits using generative AI to develop
written application content, allowing minor editing/grammar assistance only. [s3] [s6]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Math application deadline explicitly confirmed for Fall 2027; response page remains 2026. [s2] [s10]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Reference receipt; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
15 December 2026, 5:00 p.m.; program page explicitly gives date/time. Time zone not printed in that
program-page entry; verify portal Eastern-time convention. All required electronic materials and letters due by
application deadline. [s2] [s3] [s5]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Ordinary admission/financial aid through GSAS application; separate external awards follow independent
deadlines. No distinct departmental early funding date published on reviewed pages. [s1] [s8]
Test-score receipt [2027 confirmed]
Official Math GRE, if submitted, should arrive by application deadline, ETS code 3451. Any required English
scores must be sent by deadline; Fall 2027 eligible tests no earlier than 5 January 2025. [s1] [s7]
Accepting an offer [Prior cycle]
Published admitted-student page still says 15 April 2026 at 5:00 p.m. EDT. This is PRIOR cycle only; 2027 reply
date must come from assigned offer deadline. [s10]

English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Non-native speakers can establish proficiency with an English-medium undergraduate degree. Otherwise
current central minimum: TOEFL 5 overall/4.5 speaking (95/23 pre-21 Jan 2026) or IELTS 7 overall/6.5
speaking. Master’s alone does not satisfy the undergraduate-degree exemption. [s7]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
English-taught UChicago undergraduate degree meets degree-based proof of proficiency. For a degree still in
progress, verify portal handling rather than assume completed-degree wording is waived automatically. [s7] [s3]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Not accepted. [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Central program: optional. Department: recommended; without a score one less evaluation datum is available
and omission may disadvantage an otherwise marginal file. Thus optional-but-recommended, not indifferent.
[s1] [s2]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Electronic undergraduate transcript copies at application; official paper copies not required then. General
university education history must be accurately entered. [s1] [s3]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Unresolved]
Not established as a separate mathematics requirement by reviewed department/GSAS pages; confirm current
portal prompts, limits and upload/link rules. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three; at least one from faculty at latest degree institution unless out of school more than five years. Extra
letters allowed but review not guaranteed. [s5]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Ordinary GSAS package is coordinated with admission; no separate mathematics scholarship essay/reference
form identified. Fulbright/home-country and other outside awards have distinct applications. [s1] [s8]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
Not established from the public sources reviewed. Verify in the current application or with graduate admissions
before relying on this item.
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
You may submit application before letters arrive; letters still due by program deadline. Exact invitation trigger
was not stated in reviewed public guidance. [s5]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Applicant Portal tracks received materials with green checkmarks, including references and official scores. [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
No email/mail/dossier-service letters; recommender portal only. General submitted application cannot be
edited except contact information. Specific policy on replacement of submitted letters/reuse across years was
not established. [s5] [s6]

Written materials
Academic CV / resume; Research proposal; Course-list document; Other short answers / materials
[Unresolved]
Not established as a separate mathematics requirement by reviewed department/GSAS pages; confirm current
portal prompts, limits and upload/link rules. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required; default maximum 1,000 words. Math-specific prompt paraphrase: demonstrate effective
mathematical communication and deep understanding, rather than a life story or account of choosing
mathematics. General guidance also asks research interests, qualifications, past work and future goals. Upload
within application; no math-specific typography specification found. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Personal / background statement [2027 confirmed]
NOT ACCEPTED for Mathematics. The generic GSAS 500-word personal-statement prompt applies only to
selected other programs; do not draft/upload it for math. [s2]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Included in SOP; no distinct research-interest statement requirement established. [s4] [s2]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Department invites research papers, publications and original work you want evaluated. Exact upload slot,
file/page limits, and whether links substitute for files are not stated publicly; confirm before assembling. [s1]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Research/publications may be included for evaluation; no separately prescribed publication-list length or
format found. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
Ordinary GSAS package is coordinated with admission; no separate mathematics scholarship essay/reference
form identified. Fulbright/home-country and other outside awards have distinct applications. [s1] [s8]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
Incoming package covers tuition, health insurance fees and basic living expenses, but an explicit 2027-28
mathematics annual stipend was not found. Central stipend page says amounts/payment schedules vary by
individual package; do not import another department’s stipend. [s8] [s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Specific duration appears in Notice of Financial Support at admission. Department describes first-year
scholarship and teaching in years 2-5; this is not itself a precise five-year dollar guarantee. [s1] [s8]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department identifies aid for applicants without outside support and directs international students to
Fulbright/home-country awards; central package is for incoming PhD students. Individual award eligibility still
must be checked. [s1] [s8]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Continued full-time enrollment and satisfactory academic progress. Department normally expects a teaching
fellowship for one course in each of years 2-5 when not externally supported. [s1] [s8]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Ordinary GSAS package is coordinated with admission; no separate mathematics scholarship essay/reference
form identified. Fulbright/home-country and other outside awards have distinct applications. [s1] [s8]

Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Institutional scholarships/teaching/research appointments and external awards. Department lists Fulbright IIE
and home-country funding for international applicants; NSF/NDSEG generally should not be presumed eligible
solely from F-1 enrollment. [s1] [s8]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 105, nonrefundable, credit card. [s3]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Application Fee section asks eligibility questions and immediately returns a fee-waiver determination.
Complete these before paying; no separate public math waiver deadline or guaranteed international eligibility
found. [s3]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Standing rule]
Optional Math GRE centrally versus departmental recommendation is a nuance, not a requirement conflict.
Generic GSAS personal-statement instructions do not override Mathematics “Not Accepted.” [s1] [s2] [s4]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm 2027 acceptance deadline, exact math stipend/summer guarantee and duration, pending-degree
English exemption handling, current CV/course fields, research-upload limits, and letter invitation/update/reuse
mechanics. Several senior faculty lack recent paper metadata on accessible official pages. [s1] [s6] [s7] [s8] [s10]
